In pool_sweep (shared_heap.c:614-650):
- Free blocks use POOL_FREE_HEADER(N) where N = count of FOLLOWING free blocks

CORRECT FIX: For free blocks, advance by wh (current block) after skipping N following blocks. For live blocks, advance by Whsize_hd(hd).
